models.title: Land carnivore

models.summary: No day schedule, hunger or thirst. Each bird flies smooth laps around its nest (wide loops, figure eights over the nest, thermal circles that gain height), then lands, perches, looks around and takes off again. Egg thieves and, for apex flyers, intruders are circled and swooped.

RETURN_HOME: thief gone, out of the leash, unseen for 3 s, or timeout
SWOOP: swoop cooldown over and a clear line to the thief

DEFENSE_CIRCLE: egg stolen, or an intruder in an apex flyer's airspace
TAKEOFF: nest blocked or gone, water, or 10 s without touchdown

DEFENSE_CIRCLE: egg stolen while perched (takes off into the defense)

models.title: Aquatic

schedule.carnivore: Night: hunt. Morning: sleep. Afternoon: roam and drink.
schedule.flyer: No schedule: flyers loop around their nest, land, perch and take off.
schedule.herbivore: Night: sleep. Day: graze, drink and roam.

tiers.summary: Full behaviour: senses, needs (hunger, thirst, fatigue), hunting, fleeing, drinking and the timed bridges between states. Decisions twice a second.
Seen from afar: short walks, turns, stops, looking around, grazing, sniffing, pooping and the daily sleep schedule. One cheap decision every few seconds; needs frozen.
Culled: no routine. Within this radius the pose still follows the schedule (asleep or standing) on a slow timer; beyond it nothing runs.
